mainEntity.name: What is the difference between harassment and discrimination?

acceptedAnswer.text: While often related, harassment and discrimination are distinct. Discrimination refers to adverse employment actions (like not hiring, firing, or denying promotion) based on a protected characteristic. Harassment is unwelcome conduct based on a protected characteristic that creates a hostile work environment or becomes a condition of employment. Harassment can be a form of discrimination if it is severe or pervasive enough to alter the terms and conditions of employment. An attorney can help clarify which applies to your situation.
